2. **D1 edit site located.** `critic-lens-reference.md` item 16 (`**Merge-disk budget vs per-pod quota ...**`) carries exactly four extensions in order: LADDER-RETENTION (#1133 / incident #1112), FAN-OUT ACCUMULATION (#1541 / #1481), PHASE-ORDERING (#1612 / #1586 r5), MOUNT-BINDING (#1414 / #1333), ending immediately before item 17. The new extension inserts as the fifth, after MOUNT-BINDING, in the shared sibling shape (name + `(#<task>, from incident #<M>)`, trigger, `ALSO verify §9 ...`, REVISE condition + one-line incident evidence, escapes / `kind:` exemptions, plan-time-only closer).
3. **D2 is a verified conditional no-op for `critic.md`.** `.claude/agents/critic.md` does not enumerate item 16 or any of its extensions — it delegates to `.claude/rules/critic-lens-reference.md § Methodology lens` (3 pointer sites). The deliverable's own guard ("**if** that file enumerates item 16's extensions") is therefore not met. The v2 owner `.claude/agents/efficiency-critic.md:144` *does* mirror item 16, but only its base clause (transient full-precision merges vs per-pod quota) with no extension roster — same guard, same no-op. Both non-edits get recorded in the plan rather than left implicit.
4. **D3 needs no new map row.** `.claude/rules/lens-coverage-map.md` is ITEM-grained, not extension-grained: item 16 already has `| 16 Merge-disk budget vs per-pod quota | critic.md Methodology 16 | v2-owner: efficiency-critic |` and none of the four existing extensions carries its own row. `workflow_lint.py --check-lens-coverage` FAILs only on (a) an illegal State prefix and (b) a `LESSONS.md` rule with no map row — neither is touched by adding an extension to an already-covered item. Deliverable is confirm-and-record + a green no-flags lint run.
5. **Prose-pin test is the established companion.** Three of the four sibling extensions ship a dedicated durability pin (`tests/test_fanout_accumulation_prose_pins.py`, `test_phase_ordering_prose_pins.py`, `test_mount_binding_prose_pins.py`), each asserting (i) the extension text INSIDE item 16 via containment bounds (item-16 heading < clause start < item-17 heading) over whitespace-normalized text, and (ii) the bidirectional cross-ref in the `plan-compute-sizing.md` block. The new extension follows that shape.
6. **D4 is an open design call, resolved during planning with a corpus probe.** The precedent is informative: no sibling item-16 extension has a `verify_plan.py` check (no extension name appears in any `scripts/` file), and `verify_plan.py`'s c-check culture requires a persisted-plan corpus calibration with true/false-positive counts before shipping a predicate. The decision (add-with-calibration vs decline-and-record-in-the-rule-text) is grounded in a probe of the `tasks/*/*/plans/v*.md` corpus rather than asserted; either way the rule text stops disclaiming and starts stating the resolved position, per the deliverable.
